audit.whatIsWrong: Disk chart reads Ryze / Ryze / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill on both layers. That contradicts the packet chart, this page's own whys[] (which hand levels 2 through first item to Mordekaiser and two items to Ryze), and the already-applied mirror audit on mordekaiser__ryze.
audit.why: The mirror settled this chart as an atomic group: Level 1 Skill; Levels 2 through First item Mordekaiser; 2+ items Ryze. Restated from Ryze's side it is identical — sides are shared, only ratings invert. Leaving disk as-is would make mirror-fix.js overwrite it anyway.
audit.corrected: Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Ryze, proposed as seven matched full+content pairs plus the ratings that inverted with them.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly ordered: Lvl 3 (his full E-Q-W loop), Lvl 6 (Realm of Death, 140/120/100s), 1st item, 2+ items. Ryze's real spike is Seraph's, and the text says so.
audit.corrected: No spike edits; two phases[].why lines rewritten so the chart's new sides are not contradicted by the prose beside them.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d are filler that state no interaction, and the sustain interaction from missingInteractions (Indestructible) never reaches a field except one clause in report[8].
audit.why: Kit: Obliterate (Q, 8/7/6/5/4s, 675 range, no cost) deals increased damage when it hits a single target — standing outside the minion wall is what makes it a kill. Indestructible (W, 12/11/10/9/8s) stores damage dealt and taken and converts it to a heal, so chip damage without Grievous Wounds is refunded. Mirror-confirmed on Ryze's side: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux, otherwise a 615-range slow on 9-11s; Overload stops on the first enemy hit so a minion eats it; Realm Warp is a 3000-range delayed portal, not a dash, and cannot extract an ally from the death realm.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing folded into dosFull[2].d; the isolation bonus on Obliterate folded into dontsFull[0].d.

audit.why: Packet suspectNames flags 'Realm of Death's', 'Keep Realm of Death', 'Cast Realm of Death' — all three are false positives; Realm of Death is the correct R name and the flags are matching on the surrounding words.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Realm of Death is live: no minions to Flux, no Phase Rush exit, no jungler. Don't step past the wave.

edits.before: Rod of Ages ends the HP problem — your short trades become favourable on raw math.
edits.after: Rod of Ages helps, but Realm of Death still rules every step forward — wait for Seraph's.

edits.before: Mordekaiser spends Realm of Death early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Indestructible refunds your chip damage every 8-12s — buy Oblivion Orb before Rod of Ages.

edits.before: That is Mordekaiser’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Obliterate hits harder when you're alone — stay in the minion wall.

notes: Level chart proposed as one complete atomic group (7 matched full/content pairs) so it lands with the mirror rather than being overwritten by mirror-fix.js. All three packet suspectNames are false positives.
